newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss January CPI expected to show moderate rise.
newsitem.headline: Swiss January CPI expected to show moderate rise.

text.p: Switzerland's consumer price index (CPI), due around 0700 GMT on Friday, is expected to show a relatively moderate rise, economists said.
Economists at Credit Suisse said they expected January's CPI to show about a 0.1-percent rise month-on-month and a year-on-year 0.6-percent gain.
Union Bank of Switzerland expects January's CPI to rise 0.2 percent and jump 0.7 percent year-on-year.
December's CPI was reported up 0.1 percent month-on-month for a yearly rise of 0.8 percent.
One Swiss money market dealer said there seemed to be little reason for home-made inflation in Switzerland.
"There may be some upward pressure from energy prices and the weaker Swiss franc. But that is not core inflation," he said.
